search_policy.universe: Primary academic papers, exchange or central-bank research, transparent institutional research, and completely specified practitioner rules discoverable through bounded searches for time-series momentum, intraday/session momentum, opening-range effects, scheduled macro-announcement effects, gold announcement responses, order-flow imbalance, carry, turn-of-month, and volatility management.
excluded_source_types: secondary strategy summary without complete point-in-time rules

screened_sources.title: Time Series Momentum
screened_sources.mechanism: Persistence in an instrument's own excess-return sign, scaled by ex-ante volatility.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Past 12-month excess-return sign, long or short direction, inverse-volatility scaling, futures/forward implementation.
screened_sources.reason: The sealed local instruments are cash CFDs without a historically sealed financing and roll-yield series. Substituting raw CFD price returns would not be the published futures/forward excess-return rule, and trend branches already exist in the repository.

screened_sources.title: A Century of Evidence on Trend-Following Investing
screened_sources.mechanism: Diversified time-series trend persistence across liquid futures markets.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Documents diversified trend-following evidence and implementation family.
screened_sources.reason: Same economic family as EER_S01, historical futures roll and financing are unavailable, and only one representative per deduplicated family is eligible.

screened_sources.title: Market Intraday Momentum
screened_sources.mechanism: Infrequent institutional rebalancing and late-informed trading make the first and penultimate half-hour directions informative for the last half hour.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Defines p0 at the prior 16:00 ET close, p1 at 10:00, p12 at 15:30, p13 at 16:00, sign rules, entry at 15:30, and exit at 16:00.

screened_sources.title: Intraday Momentum and Return Predictability: Evidence from the Crude Oil Market
screened_sources.source_type: academic working paper subsequently peer reviewed
screened_sources.mechanism: Overnight information, late-informed trading, and liquidity provision make the first half-hour direction informative for the USO last half hour.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Defines the first-half-hour sign as signal, a long/short last-half-hour timing rule, and a same-day close.
screened_sources.mapping_limit: One preregistered mechanism-preserving transfer from USO's 09:30-16:00 ET clock to XTIUSD; no oil-specific threshold or filter is permitted.

screened_sources.title: The Pre-FOMC Announcement Drift
screened_sources.mechanism: Equity returns historically accumulated before scheduled FOMC announcements.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Scheduled-window return anomaly, but later evidence materially challenges persistence.
screened_sources.reason: The authors' later study reports that the drift essentially disappeared after 2015; selecting the original result alone would ignore contradictory pre-replication evidence.

screened_sources.title: Do Macroeconomics News Releases Affect Gold and Silver Prices?
screened_sources.mechanism: Gold and silver prices respond to scheduled macroeconomic news.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Event-response regressions; no complete point-in-time entry, stop, exit, sizing, or acceptance rule.
screened_sources.reason: Descriptive response evidence cannot be converted into a strategy without inventing rules, and gold macro-event branches were already tested.

screened_sources.title: What Moves the Gold Market?
screened_sources.mechanism: Gold volatility responds to economic announcements, trading activity, and market conditions.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Explanatory volatility model, not a directional trading rule.
screened_sources.reason: No fully specified directional entry/exit rule and substantial overlap with completed gold macro/session research.

screened_sources.title: News Sentiment and the Investor Fear Gauge
screened_sources.mechanism: News and financial-market state affect gold returns and volatility.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Econometric relation without a complete point-in-time trading policy.
screened_sources.reason: Would require inventing sentiment thresholds and execution rules; related contextual fields were already examined locally.

screened_sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
screened_sources.mechanism: Short-horizon price changes relate linearly to order-flow imbalance, inversely scaled by depth.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Price-impact relation, not a fully specified entry/exit/risk strategy.
screened_sources.reason: No complete trading policy and direct overlap with the sealed GC MBO/MBP-10 OFI and continuous state-response branches.

screened_sources.title: Common Risk Factors in Currency Markets
screened_sources.mechanism: Currency carry compensates for common global risk exposure.
screened_sources.reason: Historical forward points and point-in-time funding inputs required by the published rule are not in the sealed source set; spot-only substitution is forbidden.

screened_sources.title: A Monthly Effect in Stock Returns
screened_sources.mechanism: Average equity returns historically cluster around the turn of the month.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Calendar window anomaly with overnight exposure.
screened_sources.reason: Only 41 development months are available, below adequate independent support, and the CFD overnight financing history needed for a faithful net replication is absent.

screened_sources.title: Data-Snooping Biases in Tests of Financial Asset Pricing Models
screened_sources.mechanism: Calendar anomalies can be overstated after searching many rules.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Not a strategy; methodological control evidence.
screened_sources.reason: Supports strict multiplicity and outcome-blind selection; not a candidate.

screened_sources.title: Volatility Managed Portfolios
screened_sources.mechanism: Risk exposure is reduced when lagged realized volatility is high.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Monthly factor-portfolio scaling, not a standalone directional signal for the local CFDs.
screened_sources.reason: Requires an already tradable factor portfolio, has only 41 monthly observations locally, and would overlap existing volatility-conditioned sizing tests.

screened_sources.title: Intraday Momentum in Chinese Commodity Futures Markets
screened_sources.mechanism: First-half-hour commodity-futures returns predict last-half-hour returns.
screened_sources.reason: Same deduplicated intraday-momentum family as EER_S03/EER_S04 but a different market and unavailable component-futures dataset.

screened_sources.title: Intraday Time Series Momentum: Global Evidence and Links to Market Characteristics
screened_sources.mechanism: First-half-hour returns predict last-half-hour returns across developed equity indices.
screened_sources.reason: Publication is at the preferred cutoff and the mechanism/rule duplicates the earlier Gao family already selected.

screened_sources.title: The Rest of the Day
screened_sources.mechanism: Intraday continuation related to institutional trading and liquidity provision.
screened_sources.reason: Published after the preferred cutoff and overlaps the selected earlier intraday-momentum family.

screened_sources.title: Opening Range Breakout Evidence in Index Futures
screened_sources.authors: Academic and practitioner literature screened as a family
screened_sources.mechanism: Information incorporation and stop activation around the opening range.
screened_sources.rule_completeness: Results depend materially on selected range length, breakout buffer, exit, and market.
screened_sources.reason: Opening-range, breakout-acceptance, sweep/reclaim, and session-state rules were already exhaustively tested locally; the screened sources do not supply one uniquely mandated transferable parameterization.
